output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated by multiplying the price by the value of the payload, which can be arbitrary and potentially unsecure.
The selfdestructs function has an integer overflow where the owner's balance is used as the target for the selfdestruct function, which can be arbitrary and potentially unsecure.
